question: What share of myristic acid (C14:0) was measured in the macaw palm almond oil evaluated as a heat-transfer fluid, and what did Goncalves and Amaral report?
rendered:
According to the document, in the macaw palm almond oil evaluated as a heat-transfer fluid, the share of myristic acid (C14:0) was approximately 9.4%.

Goncalves reported 9.3% and Amaral reported 8.45%.
